title: Data and code for Service-Preserving Generative Moving Target Defense for Web Applications
description: Data-only update retaining all v2.2.0 evidence and adding five-application descriptive generation-cost accounting and four bounded Django Helpdesk API router/adapter generations. Seven Helpdesk calls include three rejected attempts; fixed HTTP contract and local rotation checks passed. Heterogeneous application scopes preclude a common cost-growth estimate. No three-arm cohort, manuscript, third-party target source, operational credential or raw model transcript is included.
